title: No-Show Rate: With vs. Without SMS Reminders
subtitle: Pediatric clinic, randomized controlled trial
description: Grouped bar chart from a randomized controlled trial at an urban pediatric clinic. The no-show rate was 38.1% in the control group that received only a standard voice message reminder, versus 23.5% in the group that also received an SMS text reminder, a 14.6 percentage point reduction (p = 0.04). Source: Lin et al., International Journal of Pediatrics, 2016.
